casepath_frontier_checklist.label: CasePath, checklist only, frontier (one run)

header: Development estimate from Study 3's stored readings; post hoc; not a result
note: The combining rules were chosen after these data (and the denied-event reading table) were seen and are scored on the same data: the numbers are an upper bound on what a redesign would show on new data. No reference answer is used by any rule; reference answers are used only to score.

V0.name: tested: all three must agree
V0.rule: study3_feedback.combine_k with k = 3, unchanged: a fact's value is admitted only when every one of the three readings admits it (a value with a quotation found word for word in the files) and they give the same value. Values that differ make the fact 'conflicting'; anything else leaves it 'unknown'. Presumptions then apply by the product's rule (workflows.presumed, open rule 'any': a fact that any reading answered 'open' with words found in the files is raised and left open, and no presumption fills it; nor does one when the first or second reading admitted a different value).

V1.name: majority on the defining event only
V1.rule: For the workflow's defining event (the fact of its 'routed' presumption: termination_received, claim_received; theft has none, so V1 = V0 there): when at least two of the three readings admit the same value (with a located quotation), that value is admitted, whatever the third reading says. Otherwise, and for every other fact, as V0.

V2.name: majority on every deciding fact
V2.rule: For every fact the readings decide (all workflow facts except those set by routing): when at least two of the three readings admit the same value, that value is admitted, whatever the third says (a different value, 'open', 'not stated', or a quotation not found). Otherwise as V0.

V3.name: a quoted denial of the defining event counts
V3.rule: For the defining event: if at least one reading admits false (answer false with a quotation found in the files) and no reading admits true, the event is admitted false. If one reading admits true and another admits false, it stays 'conflicting' (unresolved) as in V0. Otherwise as V0; every other fact as V0.

V4.name: V1, and two values outweigh one 'open'
V4.rule: As V1 for the defining event. For every other fact: when two readings admit the same value, no reading admits a different value, and the remaining reading answered 'open' (with or without words found), that value is admitted. Difference from the tested open rule 'any': under 'any', one 'open' answer with words found both prevents agreement and blocks every presumption, so the fact is held even when the other two readings quote the same value; under V4 that single 'open' is outvoted by two quoted values. A fact with at most one quoted value keeps the tested rule: any located 'open' still blocks the presumption and the fact is held. A dissent that is 'not stated' or an unlocated quotation is not changed (as V0).

V5.name: first reading alone (k = 1)
V5.rule: study3_feedback.combine_k with k = 1: the first reading's admitted values; presumptions by the same rule from the first reading's 'open' answer. For reference (one reading's cost).

V6.name: a denial by two readings counts; every other fact as V4
V6.rule: Chosen after the denied-event reading table (the readings never answered 'open' or 'not stated' on a denied event; they disagreed only true against false). For the defining event: admitted false when at least two readings admit false (whatever the third admits); admitted true only when all three admit true (as V0); otherwise as V0 (conflicting values are held). Asymmetric: a majority for the event's occurrence does not override a quoted denial. Every other fact: two quoted values outweigh one 'open' (V4's rule).

V7.name: any quoted denial counts; every other fact as V4
V7.rule: For the defining event: admitted false when at least one reading admits false, even if other readings admit true (a quoted denial outweighs a quoted occurrence); admitted true only when all three admit true; otherwise as V0. Every other fact as V4.
